Find A Local Utility

The Missouri Public Service Commission regulates investor-owned electric, natural gas, steam, water and sewer utilities in Missouri. The Commission also has limited jurisdiction over telecommunications providers in the state. In addition, the Commission regulates the operational safety of the state’s rural electric cooperatives and municipally owned natural gas utilities.


The information provided is for general reference purposes only. A county or city may be served by multiple entities. The exact location of your property will determine which electric, natural gas, or water utility serves your home.
